attempts.summary: Configured two tagged 802.1Q VLANs (10 and 20) over the shared physical link (eth0) among node1/node2/node3. node1 (OpenWrt) acts as router with 802.1Q sub-interfaces eth0.10 (10.10.10.1/24) and eth0.20 (10.10.20.1/24), each in its own firewall zone with no inter-zone forwarding rule, so fw4's default-reject applies. node2 (Alpine) tags into VLAN 10 via eth0.10 (10.10.10.2/24, gw 10.10.10.1); node3 (Alpine) tags into VLAN 20 via eth0.20 (10.10.20.2/24, gw 10.10.20.1). Configuration is persistent (UCI-committed on node1, /etc/network/interfaces on node2/node3). Verified: node2<->node1 and node3<->node1 reachable; node2<->node3 explicitly refused (hits fw4 handle_reject in the forward chain, confirmed via nft ruleset). Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id/health baseline on all 3 nodes, restarted node2, node3, then node1 one at a time (never concurrently), confirmed each node's boot_id changed and uptime reset, and re-verified VLAN interfaces, firewall isolation, and full connectivity matrix (same-VLAN reachable, cross-VLAN refused) after each restart and again after all three nodes were back up.
